end.summary:
Practised drawing dot pictures for triangular and square numbers.
Counted triangular totals: 1+2+3=6 and 1+2+3+4=10.
Used row and column pictures to explain square numbers and distinguish rectangles.
Explained that adding a row and column to a square adds 2n+1 dots; reached 25 for 12² after correcting the corner-counting mix-up.
Teach-back was not passed; unaided dot-picture drawing was not yet correct on the recorded attempt.
end.parentNote: Asha practised triangular and square numbers with dot pictures. Ishita clearly used rows and columns to explain why equal rows and columns make a square, and used the picture argument successfully twice. They briefly mixed up the shared corner when extending a square, then corrected the count to 25 later in the lesson. At home, ask them to draw a 3×3 or 4×4 square and show how adding one row and one column changes the total.
